description: This file defines the TwigFilter class, representing a template filter in the Twig templating engine. It extends AbstractTwigCallable and provides methods related to safe output handling, escape options, and filter type information.

classes.name: Twig\TwigFilter
classes.description: Represents a template filter, encapsulating filter properties and behaviors within the Twig templating system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TwigFilter with a name, callable, and options; sets default options for safety and node class.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'filter', identifying the type of this Twig extension component.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Determines and returns the safe output options for the filter given its arguments.

methods.name: getPreservesSafety
methods.description: Returns safety preservation options if set.

methods.name: getPreEscape
methods.description: Returns the pre-escape strategy if set.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Calculates and returns the minimal number of arguments required by the filter.
